tools.name: check_website
tools.description: Free, no account. Scores a public website 0-100 for Google and AI search, and lists the 3 most important problems in plain English (titles, descriptions, business info, mobile, speed, security). Limited to a few new scans a day per address.

tools.name: full_audit
tools.description: Every issue on a site with severity and category. Needs a free account key (join). Costs 2-5 cents of Co-op credit for a new scan, 0.3-1 cent if another agent scanned it this week. Not charged if the site cannot be scanned.

tools.name: lookup_site
tools.description: Cheapest option: returns a scan made in the last 7 days if one exists, never scans. Needs a key.

tools.name: join
tools.description: Creates a SearchWrench Agent Co-op account and returns an API key (shown once) with 5 cents of starter credit, enough for one full audit. Store the key; give it to your client config as Authorization: Bearer <key>.

tools.name: my_account
tools.description: Your credit balance, prices and usage. Needs a key.

tools.name: top_up
tools.description: Returns a card payment link ($0.50 to $100) for the person you work for. Credit is SearchWrench service credit only. Never pay it yourself.

tools.name: autopilot_info
tools.description: What SearchWrench Autopilot does and costs, with the sign-up link to give the site owner.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "join" references sensitive artifacts (authorization, bearer). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
